name: OpenRouter Video Edit
summary: Edits your clip with a hosted model through OpenRouter: swap a person, change the place, relight, new angle. The Editing Room stacks these edits.

inputs.label: Your clip
inputs.help: OpenRouter takes the clip only as a web link: while the edit runs, a random one-off link (a Cloudflare quick tunnel) serves this one file, and it closes when the edit ends.

inputs.label: Reference image
inputs.help: Optional: the person, outfit or place to put in. Seedance and Hailuo use it; FLUX and Runway go by the prompt alone.

inputs.label: What to change
inputs.default: Relight the scene with warm golden sunset light from the left; keep the people, their motion and the framing unchanged

inputs.label: Model
inputs.help: OpenRouter's prices in November 2026, per second of the result.

options.label: FLUX Video Edit · $0.03/s · objects, people, places, light
Seedance 2.5 · per token · follows a reference image
Runway Aleph 2 · $0.28/s (min $0.56) · new angles, camera, relight

inputs.label: Length (s)
inputs.help: For models that need a length (Hailuo 3): the source's length, moved to the nearest they offer. The others follow the source.

inputs.label: Sound
inputs.help: Models that make audio add it (Seedance, Hailuo).

notes: Runs on OpenRouter, not on your GPU. Needs cloudflared (CLOUDFLARED or on PATH): only the files of a running edit are served through it, from a separate local server, never the studio. A canceled run stops here only: OpenRouter has no cancel call.
